The stop hook failed again, with the same cause as last time. The Postgres UUID test in `src/db/db.test.ts` can't reach `127.0.0.1:5432`, and I can't start a database here because Docker isn't installed. The log excerpt shows only that connection error. It doesn't show which tests failed.

The fix itself is done. The check I ran covers only the organization plugin: all 7 test files pass, including the two new tests for `cancelPendingInvitationsOnReInvite`. I haven't edited, weakened or skipped any tests to get around the hook.

I'm stopping here because I can't change the result of this hook. A clean run needs Postgres from `docker compose up -d` somewhere Docker is available. The other option is to point the hook at the organization tests only.
